name: ERP Card (Basic)
description: Standard content card with shadow and header
xaml:
<Border StrokeShape="RoundRectangle 12" StrokeThickness="0" BackgroundColor="White" Padding="16" Margin="0,0,0,12">
    <Border.Shadow>
        <Shadow Brush="Black" Offset="0,4" Radius="10" Opacity="0.05" />
    </Border.Shadow>
    <VerticalStackLayout Spacing="8">
        <Label Text="Card Title" FontSize="16" FontAttributes="Bold" TextColor="#1f2937" />
        <BoxView HeightRequest="1" Color="#f3f4f6" />
        <Label Text="Card content goes here. Details about the ERP item." TextColor="#6b7280" FontSize="14" />
    </VerticalStackLayout>
</Border>

name: ERP Bound Card
xaml:
<Border StrokeShape="RoundRectangle 12" StrokeThickness="0" BackgroundColor="White" Padding="16" Margin="0,0,0,12">
    <Border.Shadow>
        <Shadow Brush="Black" Offset="0,4" Radius="10" Opacity="0.05" />
    </Border.Shadow>
    <VerticalStackLayout Spacing="8">
        <Label Text="{Binding Title}" FontSize="16" FontAttributes="Bold" TextColor="#1f2937" />
        <BoxView HeightRequest="1" Color="#f3f4f6" />
        <Label Text="{Binding Description}" TextColor="#6b7280" FontSize="14" />
    </VerticalStackLayout>
</Border>

name: ERP Filter Bar
description: Search input and filter buttons row
xaml:
<Grid ColumnDefinitions="*, Auto, Auto" ColumnSpacing="12" Padding="16" BackgroundColor="White">
    <Border Grid.Column="0" StrokeShape="RoundRectangle 8" Stroke="#e5e7eb" StrokeThickness="1" Padding="12,0" HeightRequest="44">
        <Grid ColumnDefinitions="Auto, *" ColumnSpacing="8">
            <Label Text="🔍" VerticalOptions="Center" TextColor="#9ca3af" />
            <Entry Text="{Binding SearchQuery, Mode=TwoWay}" Placeholder="Search records..." VerticalOptions="Center" TextColor="#374151" BackgroundColor="Transparent" />
        </Grid>
    </Border>
    <Button Grid.Column="1" Command="{Binding FilterCommand}" Text="Filter" BackgroundColor="#f3f4f6" TextColor="#374151" CornerRadius="8" HeightRequest="44" Padding="16,0" />
    <Button Grid.Column="2" Command="{Binding ExportCommand}" Text="Export" BackgroundColor="#f3f4f6" TextColor="#374151" CornerRadius="8" HeightRequest="44" Padding="16,0" />
</Grid>

name: ERP Data Table
description: CollectionView with header row and striped rows
xaml:
<Grid RowDefinitions="Auto, *">
    <!-- Header -->
    <Grid Grid.Row="0" ColumnDefinitions="2*, 3*, 2*, Auto" Padding="16,12" BackgroundColor="#f9fafb">
        <Label Grid.Column="0" Text="ID" Metadata="Bold" TextColor="#6b7280" FontSize="12" />
        <Label Grid.Column="1" Text="NAME" Metadata="Bold" TextColor="#6b7280" FontSize="12" />
        <Label Grid.Column="2" Text="STATUS" Metadata="Bold" TextColor="#6b7280" FontSize="12" />
        <Label Grid.Column="3" Text="ACTIONS" Metadata="Bold" TextColor="#6b7280" FontSize="12" />
    </Grid>
    <!-- List -->
    <CollectionView Grid.Row="1" ItemsSource="{Binding Items}">
        <CollectionView.ItemTemplate>
            <DataTemplate>
                <Grid ColumnDefinitions="2*, 3*, 2*, Auto" Padding="16,12">
                    <Label Grid.Column="0" Text="{Binding Id}" TextColor="#111827" />
                    <Label Grid.Column="1" Text="{Binding Name}" TextColor="#374151" />
                    <Border Grid.Column="2" HorizontalOptions="Start" BackgroundColor="#d1fae5" StrokeShape="RoundRectangle 4" Padding="8,2">
                         <Label Text="Active" TextColor="#065f46" FontSize="11" />
                    </Border>
                    <Label Grid.Column="3" Text="..." TextColor="#9ca3af" />
                </Grid>
            </DataTemplate>
        </CollectionView.ItemTemplate>
    </CollectionView>
</Grid>

name: ERP Input Field
description: Label, Entry and Error Message stack
xaml:
<VerticalStackLayout Spacing="6">
    <Label Text="{Binding FieldLabel}" TextColor="#374151" FontSize="14" FontAttributes="Bold" />
    <Border StrokeShape="RoundRectangle 6" Stroke="#d1d5db" StrokeThickness="1" Padding="12,0" HeightRequest="42" BackgroundColor="White">
        <Entry Text="{Binding FieldValue, Mode=TwoWay}" Placeholder="Enter value" VerticalOptions="Center" TextColor="#1f2937" PlaceholderColor="#9ca3af" />
    </Border>
    <Label Text="{Binding ValidationError}" TextColor="#dc2626" FontSize="12" IsVisible="{Binding HasError}" />
</VerticalStackLayout>

name: ERP Stat Graph (Mock)
xaml:
<Border StrokeShape="RoundRectangle 12" BackgroundColor="White" Padding="20">
    <VerticalStackLayout Spacing="16">
        <Grid ColumnDefinitions="*, Auto">
            <VerticalStackLayout>
                <Label Text="Total Revenue" TextColor="#6b7280" FontSize="14" />
                <Label Text="{Binding TotalRevenue, StringFormat='{0:C}'}" TextColor="#111827" FontSize="24" FontAttributes="Bold" />
            </VerticalStackLayout>
            <Border Grid.Column="1" BackgroundColor="#dbeafe" StrokeShape="RoundRectangle 8" Padding="8">
                <Label Text="{Binding RevenueGrowth}" TextColor="#1e40af" FontSize="12" FontAttributes="Bold" />
            </Border>
        </Grid>
        <!-- Mock Bars -->
        <Grid ColumnDefinitions="*,*,*,*,*,*,*" HeightRequest="100" ColumnSpacing="8" VerticalOptions="End">
            <BoxView Grid.Column="0" Color="#e5e7eb" HeightRequest="40" VerticalOptions="End" CornerRadius="4" />
            <BoxView Grid.Column="1" Color="#e5e7eb" HeightRequest="60" VerticalOptions="End" CornerRadius="4" />
            <BoxView Grid.Column="2" Color="#3b82f6" HeightRequest="85" VerticalOptions="End" CornerRadius="4" />
            <BoxView Grid.Column="3" Color="#e5e7eb" HeightRequest="55" VerticalOptions="End" CornerRadius="4" />
            <BoxView Grid.Column="4" Color="#e5e7eb" HeightRequest="70" VerticalOptions="End" CornerRadius="4" />
            <BoxView Grid.Column="5" Color="#e5e7eb" HeightRequest="45" VerticalOptions="End" CornerRadius="4" />
            <BoxView Grid.Column="6" Color="#e5e7eb" HeightRequest="90" VerticalOptions="End" CornerRadius="4" />
        </Grid>
    </VerticalStackLayout>
</Border>

name: ERP Popup Overlay
xaml:
<Grid IsVisible="{Binding IsPopupVisible}" BackgroundColor="#66000000" IgnoreSafeArea="True">
    <Border HorizontalOptions="Center" VerticalOptions="Center" WidthRequest="320" BackgroundColor="White" StrokeShape="RoundRectangle 16" Padding="24">
        <Border.Shadow>
            <Shadow Brush="Black" Offset="0,10" Radius="20" Opacity="0.2" />
        </Border.Shadow>
        <VerticalStackLayout Spacing="20">
            <Label Text="{Binding PopupTitle}" FontSize="20" FontAttributes="Bold" HorizontalTextAlignment="Center" />
            <Label Text="{Binding PopupMessage}" HorizontalTextAlignment="Center" TextColor="#6b7280" />
            <Grid ColumnDefinitions="*,*" ColumnSpacing="12">
                <Button Grid.Column="0" Command="{Binding CancelCommand}" Text="Cancel" BackgroundColor="#f3f4f6" TextColor="#374151" CornerRadius="20" />
                <Button Grid.Column="1" Command="{Binding ConfirmCommand}" Text="Confirm" BackgroundColor="#2563eb" TextColor="White" CornerRadius="20" />
            </Grid>
        </VerticalStackLayout>
    </Border>
</Grid>
